visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a beverage cup. A hand wearing a black glove uses a paper to transfer a large, fragile piece of metallic gold foil onto a base of swirled white and pale green cream. Yellow text with red outlines is superimposed at the top of the frame. (2) A man with short black hair, wearing a black leather jacket over a black turtleneck, sits in a car with white leather seats. He holds the drink cup in one hand and points to it with the other, speaking directly to the camera with varied facial expressions. (3) A series of close-up shots show the drink's top layer being garnished. After the gold foil, dark chocolate chips and light brown crushed nuts are sprinkled over the textured light green cream. The background for these shots is neutral and studio-like. (4) The man in the car uses a white plastic spoon to sample the cream. He looks at the spoon carefully before eating. The camera captures him from a medium-close shot as he gestures with the spoon while talking. (5) He puts a thin white straw into the cup and drinks the liquid at the bottom. The lighting inside the car is bright but natural, showing a glimpse of an urban street outside the window.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched bubble pop SFX occurs followed immediately by a male voice speaking enthusiastically about a 300 NTD milk tea price. Upbeat electronic BGM with a strong, synthesized drum beat starts. (2) The vocal continues with a friendly, professional narrative tone, explaining the brand 'UG' and the details of their gold foil topping. The music maintains a steady rhythm under the clear speech. (3) The speaker's tone shifts slightly to a descriptive mode, detailing the melon flavor and the addition of chocolate and salted walnuts. The speech rate is fast but articulation is extremely clear. (4) A short pause in speech occurs as the speaker is heard making a soft chewing sound. He then provides a critique of the cream's sweetness and the tea's quality with a slightly lower arousal level. (5) The audio concludes with a humorous emphasis on the high cost of the gold foil. The vocal intensity rises slightly at the very end before a hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a review of a high-priced, luxury milk tea featuring gold foil from the brand UG. It focuses on the visual novelty of the product and evaluates whether the taste justifies the high price tag.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social media food review editing styles with fast cuts and large text overlays to maintain viewer attention. The focus is on the 'luxurious' nature of the product.
